name: Sign in and reach the private dashboard
description: Verifies a user can authenticate and see their own FitSphere dashboard and main navigation.
expected: The signed-in dashboard loads with Home, Workouts, Activity and Profile navigation.

name: Browse and filter workout plans
description: Verifies workout categories filter the library and a selected session shows its outline and safety guidance.
expected: Only strength sessions are listed and the selected workout shows its exercise outline and adaptation guidance.

name: Complete a workout and retain its activity record
description: Verifies completing a suggested session saves a private activity record that remains in the activity history.
steps: Refresh FitSphere and return to Activity
expected: Morning mobility appears in the activity log with its duration and remains after refresh.

name: Validate and save a custom activity
description: Verifies invalid durations are rejected and a valid custom activity is saved to the signed-in user's history.
steps: Open Activity and choose Log activity
Enter an activity name and set minutes to 0
Submit and confirm the form does not save
expected: The invalid duration is blocked; the valid 20-minute activity appears in the activity list.

name: Keep account data separate and sign out
description: Verifies profile details are shown for the current account and signing out returns to the secure entry screen.
expected: The account session ends, activity data is cleared from the visible app state, and the sign-in screen is shown.
